title: Proportionality constant k
description: Essential: Correctly solves for k using equilibrium of forces before voltage is applied, yielding k = (m_0^(2/3) * g * t) / h_1.

title: Charges and polarities
description: Essential: Correctly identifies droplet A as uncharged (q_A = 0) and droplet B as having a negative charge with magnitude q_B = (m_0 * g * d * (h_1 + h_2)) / (h_1 * U).

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law (force equilibrium) for uniform motion, both for the initial fall and for droplet B's rise after the field is applied.

title: Potential energy change
description: Important: Correctly calculates the change in potential energy for B as ΔE_p = - (U/d) * q_B * h_2, leading to ΔE_p = - (m_0 * g * h_2 * (h_1 + h_2)) / h_1.

title: Post-collision velocity
description: Important: Determines the new droplet's uniform velocity magnitude and direction using momentum conservation and force equilibrium, considering the two cases (h2 > h1 or h1 > h2).

title: Air resistance model application
description: Important: Correctly uses the given air resistance formula f = k * m^(1/3) * v in setting up force balance equations.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the polarity of droplet B (e.g., positive) or misinterprets the direction of the electric force relative to the field.

title: Velocity relation error
description: Pitfall: Fails to relate uniform velocities to given distances and time (v = h/t) or misapplies this to the post-collision motion.

title: Mass exponent mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly handles the m^(1/3) factor in the air resistance, especially for the combined droplet of mass 2m_0.
